identity.title: Add evidence drill-down and provenance honesty

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Make every finding inspectable by exposing representative real OpenAIRE records. Evidence is the differentiator, not decorative metadata.
human_pressure.why_now: Without evidence the tool collapses into another AI assertion UI.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.

machine_core.goal: Implement compact evidence lists, stable links/identifiers, source labeling and explicit demo-fixture labeling.
invariants: Evidence records originate from provider responses or clearly labelled fixtures.
failure_semantics: Missing evidence for a type is shown as absent, not synthesized.

steps.title: Render evidence by type
details: Show type, title, year when available and a stable link/id.

steps.title: Preserve source semantics
details: Do not display generated citation data not returned by provider.

steps.title: Label fixture mode
details: If fixture mode exists, visibly label it as demo/fixture data.

acceptance: At least two live evidence items can be inspected for the golden topic.
Fixture mode cannot masquerade as live.

must_check: At least two live evidence items can be inspected for the golden topic.
Fixture mode cannot masquerade as live.
reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
